title: Justin George (Aurora flooring company owner) — 'Turns out the pressure is the same at any size'
summary: Justin George — owner of a flooring company in Aurora, CO — reads Incorruptible expecting it to be for founders with boards and investors, and finds the pressure applies to his small business too. Substantive small-business owner reaction proving the book scales down as well as up.
blockquote: I wasn't sure how relevant Incorruptible would be to me. Eric Ries is writing for founders with boards and investors. I run a small flooring company in Aurora. Turns out the pressure is the same at any size.
